stock.description: Huajin International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on the production and sale of cold-rolled and galvanized steel across the People's Republic of China and Southeast Asian regions. Its product offerings include cold-rolled carbon steel in the form of strips and sheets, welded steel tubes, and a variety of zinc-coated steel products. These materials are supplied to numerous industries, such as light industrial hardware, home appliance manufacturing, furniture production, motorcycle and bicycle accessory makers, as well as businesses within the LED and lighting sectors. The company, established in 2005, has its corporate headquarters situated in Jiangmen, PRC, and operates as a subsidiary of Haiyi Limited.
